name: net.towneh.vrsl-urp
description: Standalone Unity 6 / URP 17+ realtime lighting and raymarched volumetric beams driven from DMX or AudioLink data. Render-pass injection at runtime, no URP Renderer Feature changes, no project-side renderer settings touched. Co-installable with com.acchosen.vr-stage-lighting (asset GUIDs, shader names, and runtime globals are namespaced to avoid collision); existing upstream scenes continue to work alongside.

samples.description: Editor utility and synthetic DMX source for benchmarking the realtime light path. Builds a deterministic profiling scene with N matched fixtures, a fixed-pose camera, and a CRT-bypass DMX source so frame-to-frame variance is controlled.
